lead: A null test on the left of a `&&` does not narrow the operand on its right.
body: `$name != null && Core\Str::length($name) > 2` is `E0401` at `$name`, because `rule:types/narrowing` is branch-local: the narrowing reaches the `if` body, not the operand written beside the test. Write the second check in a nested `if`, or reach the value through `?->` or `??` — and when a guard is only wanted for a throw, the ordinary `$count != 0 && $total / $count > 10.0` shape needs no narrowing at all.
